title: Studio translations: the translation table offers no row for the package's own name and description, so an admin cannot translate them without code
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Blocked-by: #37933

## Why this matters

After #35513 (PR #37933), Setup › 软件包 and the Studio package switcher show a package's name in the user's language, read from the translation bundle's new `packages` group. Studio's translation editor is where an admin fills in translations for a stack's objects, fields and other keys, and it offers no row for the package's own name or description. The admin who sees an untranslated package name, or the new `i18n/missing-package` warning, can only fix it by editing the translation source in code. Everything else they translate in Studio. L1-b raised this on #37933 (ACCEPT 7220739710).

## Acceptance

- Studio's translation table lists, per locale, the package's `name` and `description` under the `packages` group, keyed by the package's manifest id, and saving writes them into that group.
- An empty cell falls back to `manifest.name` and `manifest.description` in the console, the same as the bundle path.
- Tests pin the row's presence and a save round trip. The preview cards for the translation categories include the group.

## Out of scope

`os validate` checking `packages` keys is the sibling card. Teaching the group is #37988.
